source: https://claude.com/pricing (https://www.anthropic.com/pricing redirects there), Claude Haiku 4.5 standard API list prices read by hand on 2026-09-18: $1/MTok input, $5/MTok output, $0.10/MTok prompt-cache read, $1.25/MTok prompt-cache write at the default five-minute TTL. Two identifiers are priced for one model deliberately: `Budget::validate` decides whether `--max-cost-microunits` is enforceable from the model the run asked for (the `claude` provider's alias table resolves `haiku` to `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001`), while `RateCard::price` prices the model the provider reported on each turn, which may be the undated family identifier. Pricing only one of the two would make the ceiling enforceable and the cost silently absent, or the reverse.
